issues.where: terrain sky above and to the right of the main plasma arch (pair-04-b.png, crops C and H)
issues.what: A scalloped dark seam follows the outside of the arch, separating the warm haze from the black sky. In the target the haze fades continuously into the star field.
issues.fix: Remove the dark contour and feather the warm haze into a continuous sky while retaining the fine outer filaments.

issues.where: solar disk limb, especially the lower arc and both shoulders (pair-02-b.png, crops B–G)
issues.what: A thin, nearly continuous yellow-orange outline makes the limb look smoother and more sharply traced than the target's ragged, textured transition into the corona.
issues.fix: Dim and break up the outline, carry the photospheric texture closer to the edge, and blend it into the coronal rays.

issues.where: photosphere just inside the limb, especially the sides and lower arc (pair-02-b.png, crops B–G)
issues.what: A smooth amber veil flattens the contrast in the outer surface granules. The target keeps distinct dark channels and sharp glowing ridges nearly to the edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the inner amber veil and restore local contrast in the outer granulation without sharpening the silhouette.

issues.where: outer hold-frame sky and galactic dust band (pair-02-b.png, crops H and I)
issues.what: Foreground stars are brighter and more conspicuous, pulling attention away from the target's subtle blue and rust dust structure.
issues.fix: Tone down the bright star points and retain the diffuse blue and rust mottling at the target's contrast.

issues.where: terrain horizon and both plasma footpoints (pair-04-b.png, crops A, F, G and I)
issues.what: The footpoints cast broader yellow pools across the surface, and the horizon reads more like a continuous bright strip. The target has tighter white-hot roots and a more finely broken fringe of upright strands.
issues.fix: Tighten and whiten the roots, reduce lateral spill onto the granules, and restore variation in the horizon glow and fringe.

issues.where: main arch, particularly the crest and descending right bundle (pair-04-b.png, crops C, G and H)
issues.what: The arch reads more uniformly orange, with stronger emphasis on the dense main bundle and less separation between the pale hot strands and faint outer threads.
issues.fix: Restore the pale gold highlights on the hottest strands and separate the fine outer threads without increasing the surrounding haze.

issues.where: central sunspot interior and inner rim (pair-04-b.png, crop A)
issues.what: The left interior has a distinct slanted dark patch and less of the target's subtle mottling, making the black core look unevenly masked.
issues.fix: Blend the patch into the deep core and restore faint warm mottling and irregular inner-edge detail.

issues.where: terrain star field, including the upper-left galactic band, inside the arch, and far-right sky (pair-04-b.png, crops A–C and H–I)
issues.what: More stars read as large, high-contrast white or blue points. The target has finer stars and more breathing room for the diffuse dust and arc light.
issues.fix: Reduce the star peaks and apparent point size across the terrain sky while preserving the diffuse dust texture.
